question: Detect germline SNPs and indels from exome sequencing data. Filter SNPs and indels separately and generate a tabix index for each.

expected_output.guidelines: Indel variant records (CHROM, POS, REF, ALT, FILTER) must match the reference; caller header lines and INFO-field order may differ.
The file must be a valid tabix index for the companion VCF.gz file; internal byte layout may differ.
Variant records (CHROM, POS, REF, ALT, FILTER) must match the reference; caller header lines and INFO-field order may differ.
The index answers tabix range queries with the same variant records as the reference; internal byte layout across tabix versions may differ.
